name: Curated Algebra Reference Brain
purpose: Replace repeated uploads of huge source books with a compact, section-aware library of strong source excerpts, question structures, Math Note ideas, tables, visuals, and future-resource hooks.
rules: Use the original Assessment Plan for what belongs where.
Use the curated library to improve how content is worded, represented, varied, and scaffolded.
Search the compact source_documents.jsonl only when the curated section packet is insufficient.
Do not require the full textbooks/CPM archive for ordinary Bank/Notes/course builds.
Source-reference image crops are models to inspect/adapt; approved prior-Bank figures may be directly reused when still answer-neutral and context-fit.
Tables are reusable structures; swap values/context to fit the exact canonical item rather than blindly copying one data set.
Math Note ideas support downstream Notes; they do not override the canonical Bank items or Assessment Plan.

Activities use finalized Bank items as canonical mathematical content and may use the curated library only to understand representation/section context; do not let enrichment references silently replace canonical selected Bank questions.
